run_hierarchical_generation: run the main function to generate text from prompts using a hierarchical transformer model
load_consolidated_model_and_tokenizer: load a consolidated HierarchicalTransformer model, tokenizer, and regex pool from a checkpoint directory
create_causal_sliding_mask: create a causal sliding window attention mask function with a configurable window size
init_model_and_tokenizer: initialize a HierarchicalTransformer model and tokenizer from a config file without loading weights
prefill_hierarchical_generator: prefill the hierarchical generator cache by encoding prompts through encoders, trunk, and decoders
